title: The cloud tests prove 'Rest is over' only on a plain Google phone with no watch, never on OPPO, Xiaomi or Samsung
what: The release gate and the phone-conditions run put the phone to sleep and check that 'Rest is over' fires, but both use one plain Google Pixel cloud phone. Phone makers such as OPPO, Xiaomi and Samsung add their own battery and banner rules that most often hold this alert back, and none of them is ever used. The watch checks run a watch alone, with no phone paired, so the alert reaching the wrist is never tried. The real-phone robot run only taps through screens looking for crashes and is not switched on. A green release therefore says nothing about the phones most Indian members carry.
expected: Before a release, the rest alert and its sound are checked at least once on an OPPO or Xiaomi phone and with a paired watch, or the release notes say plainly that only a plain Google phone was checked.
who: members on OPPO, Xiaomi, Samsung phones and watch wearers
fix_line: Add one real OPPO or Xiaomi phone and one paired-watch rest alert check to the pre-release test list

title: A part that keeps going down and up opens a fresh outage note and email each time
what: The outage note closes itself after one good check. If the same part fails again at the next check, a brand-new note is opened and a new email goes out, instead of reopening the last one. A part that blinks on and off all evening sends a stream of separate open and close emails, and the history is split over many notes.
expected: A part that comes back is watched for a short while before the note closes, and a repeat failure soon after reopens the same note.
fix_line: Close only after two good checks in a row and reopen a note closed in the last hour
